description: A consolidated brain: the summary names the household, relations, hobbies and pets with links, states only what the pages state, and stays within the budget.
me:
Prefers the home temperature set to 20.5 °C.
Lives at [[Home]] in Almere. Works at [[Schuberg Philis]].
Family: brother [[Dimitri]], Mom [[Cora]] and Dad [[Renee]].
Cats: [[Oreo]] and [[Sylvester]].
Hobbies: [[Motorcycles]], [[Gaming]] and [[RC racing]].
On weekdays, wakes up around 07:30 and goes to bed around 23:45.

pages.name: Oreo
pages.body: One of Raymond's two cats; female.

pages.name: Sylvester
pages.body: One of Raymond's two cats; male.

pages.name: Motorcycles
pages.body: Raymond owns a customized Suzuki Bandit and a 1979 Honda CB900F, being restored.

pages.name: Gaming
pages.body: Plays Battlefield 6 with friends in the evening, or races in iRacing.

pages.name: RC racing
pages.body: Races 1:10 RC cars on summer weekends: an Exotek Ultra F1 and an Xray X4 '26.
